posts.preview: On Monday, 12 October 2026, the Parliamentary Standing Committee on Poverty Eradication, Labour and Industrial Relations will conduct oversight visits to various shops in the Khomas Region as it finalises its investigation into conditions of employment in the retail and wholesale sector
This morning, the Committee paid a courtesy visit to the Khomas Regional Governor, Hon. Sam Nujoma, and the leadership of the Khomas Regional Council See less
